name: OSM Importer TF3 Vanilla (Preview)
summary: Vanilla OSM importer with an in-game button, scrollable commands and adjustable settings.
description: Preview standalone rebuild of VacuumTube's OSM Importer. No workshop dependencies. Prepare OSM XML with the companion converter, then click OSM Import in the game's mod button area for commands, category selection and adjustable import pace. References vanilla resources only. Native TF3 import and panel rendering are not yet verified. Signals and functioning towns require the game tools; place names use markers. See README.txt.
